REPORT INFORMATION
Basis for report preparation
BIDV's Sustainability Report is designed to provide transparent and 
detailed information on activities, strategies and achievements that 
bank has accomplished in sustainable development. This report is 
not only for evaluating the bank's performance but also showing 
our commitment to stakeholders in implementing social and 
environmental responsibilities. This report was approved and issued 
by the Board of Directors of BIDV, and is published on the Bank’s 
official website.
This Sustainability Report has been prepared in accordance with 
the following regulations, standards and guidelines:
 • 
Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) Standards 2021 (updated July 
2021)
 • 
United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
 • 
Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) 
Climate-related Financial Disclosures Framework.
 • 
Circular 96/2020/TT-BTC providing guidelines on disclosure of 
information on securities market issued by the Minister of Finance 
on November 16, 2020.
Feedback
This report presents official information on BIDV's strategies, 
principles, initiatives, and performance on core aspects of 
Environment, Society, and Governance (ESG). The report covers 
related information the financial year from January 1 to December 
31, 2024. This report is used in conjunction with the 2024 Annual 
Report and other sustainability-related information on the Bank's 
website.
 • 
Reporting frequency: Annually.
 •

operations, including the Head Office, 189 branches, 895 
transaction offices operating in sixty-three provinces and cities in 
Vietnam. The financial figures in this report are referenced from the 
audited financial statements for 2024.

BIDV SUSTAINABILITY REPORT
OVERVIEW OF SUSTAINABILITY REPORT
2024

right from the time of building the strategy for the period 2021 – 
2025, a vision to 2030, BIDV has determined "towards sustainable 
development" as a consistent goal in banking activities, with the Vision 
of "Pioneering in creating sustainable values". The implementation 
of the National Strategy on Green Growth and the National Strategy 
on Climate Change was integrated into the process of orientation, 
development and implementation of BIDV's strategy and plan to 
promote green credit, environmental, social and governance (ESG) risk 
management. Accordingly, BIDV pursues the strategy of positioning 
the Green Bank Brand, becoming a market leader in ESG practices and 
sustainable finance, gradually approaching international standards on 
green finance and implementing the roadmap to transform into a Net-
Zero Bank by 2045.
Leading bank in green finance
As the bank with the largest credit scale in the system, BIDV always has 
a clear strategic vision on developing green credit and green banking. 
The bank has been always a pioneer in implementing "green credit" 
packages, dedicating a proportionate resources to financing customers 
in the fields of renewable energy, clean energy, low-carbon production 
and consumption industries, adapting to climate change, thereby 
contributing to transforming the economy towards green growth, 
protecting the environment, preventing climate change, improving the 
efficiency of resource and energy use, demonstrating responsibility to 
the community and the environment.
BIDV is the first Vietnamese commercial bank to issue a ‘Sustainable 
Loan Framework’ and a ‘Green Bond Framework’ in accordance with 
international standards, to provide green, social, and sustainability-
linked loan products to domestic corporate clients, focusing on 
financing customers in the fields of renewable energy, clean energy, 
and low-carbon manufacturing and consumption industries. Besides, 
BIDV also issued an Environmental and Social Management System 
in Trade Finance (ESMS Framework), marking a pioneering step in 
accompanying import-export enterprises to promote global trade, 
strengthen value chains, and achieve sustainable growth.
Green credit has been determined by BIDV as one of the top priority 
targets in its long-term strategy. With the current green loan balance, 
BIDV plans to continue to increase its loan balance and green credit 
ratio annually and strive to maintain its position as one of the leading 
banks in terms of market share and green credit scale provided to the 
market. For enterprises, BIDV has implemented a number of green 
credit programs such as VND4,200 billion credit package for textile and 
garment enterprises that meet international sustainability standards/
certificates, VND10,000 billion package for environmentally friendly, 
resource-saving and efficient projects, VND5,000 billion package to 
finance clean water production and supply projects, etc. For individual 
customers, BIDV has implemented a VND10,000 billion loan package to 
serve the needs of life using green energy products, renewable energy 
or production and business in the green sector, etc. Moreover, BIDV also 
strengthens collaboration with major domestic and foreign electric car 
companies to implement policies for individuals to borrow money to 
buy cars. By the end of December 31, 2024, BIDV maintained its leading 
position in the market in green sector financing with a total of 1,982 
projects, for 1,600 customers, with outstanding loans reaching VND80.8 
trillion (equivalent to USD 3.2 billion), accounting for 4% of BIDV's total 
outstanding credit and about 11.5% of the total outstanding loans for 
the green sector of the entire economy.

Green Bank Strategy
The world is facing climate change, energy crisis and environmental 
degradation risk. As one of the pioneering countries promoting green 
economic development and circular economy, at the 26th Conference 
of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate 
Change (COP26), the Vietnamese Prime Minister made Vietnam's 
commitment to bring Net Emissions to "0" by 2050. Therefore, Green 
Financial Development is an inevitable direction of Vietnam in its efforts 
to achieve the above goal. The Green Banking Development Project in 
Vietnam, issued under Decision 1604/QD-NHNN dated August 7, 2018, 
set a common goal for the entire industry: "gradually greening banking 
activities, directing credit flows into financing environmentally friendly 
projects, promoting green production, services and consumption, clean 
energy and renewable energy; actively contributing to promoting green 
growth and sustainable development".

BIDV SUSTAINABILITY REPORT
OVERVIEW OF SUSTAINABILITY REPORT
2024

In terms of capital mobilization activities, in 2024, following the success 
of the VND 2,500 billion Green Bond issuance in 2023, BIDV launched 
the Green Deposit product in June 2024, successfully mobilizing 
VND 5,000 billion. In September 2024, BIDV successfully issued VND 
3,000 billion of sustainable bonds in compliance with the Guidelines 
of the International Capital Market Association (ICMA). With this 
issuance, BIDV has become the first organization to successfully issue 
sustainable bonds in the domestic market. Through two consecutive 
green bond and sustainable bond issuances in two consecutive years 
with a total successful offering value of VND 5,500 billion (~ USD 220 
million), BIDV continues to maintain its position as the No.1 ESG bond 
issuing credit institution in the domestic market, while contributing to 
the development of the sustainable finance sector in Vietnam. 
In addition to providing green credit from commercial capital, BIDV is 
a strategic partner of many international financial institutions and is 
the leading bank in foreign capital trust activities serving sustainable 
development goals. Up to now, BIDV has been managing more than 250 
foreign capital trusts from the governments of Germany, Switzerland, 
France, Japan, Korea and major international financial institutions such 
as WB, AFD, ADB, KFW, NIB, EIB, JICA, EDCF, WHO, UNICEF, etc. with 
a total committed value of USD19.7 billion (equivalent to VND500,000 
billion).
Comprehensive Digital Transformation to Build an 
Ecosystem of Green Banking Products
With a vision to become a large, strong, green bank by 2030, being the 
leading financial institution in Southeast Asia, with the best digital platform 
in Vietnam, BIDV focused our resources to accelerate comprehensive 
digital transformation in all aspects of operations, applying technology 
along with building environmentally friendly habits for customers within 
the framework of banking products and services, strongly developing 
electronic transaction channels, services, and new payment methods on 
technology platforms to build an ecosystem of green banking products, 
such as: "Green savings, healthy life", "Green loans for Textile and Garment 
enterprises", "Steady steps for a green life" packages for individual 
customers, "Hello Green Summer with BIDV card", "Green Journey with 
BIDV" products in order to increase the number of customers receiving 
email statements and not receiving paper statements.
Towards the Net Zero target
BIDV has comprehensively and consistently implemented a sustainable 
development strategy, promptly established a Steering Committee and 
a Project Management Board to develop and implement a sustainable 
development strategy and overall ESG practices with the goal of making 
BIDV the leading bank in the Vietnamese market in promoting green 
and sustainable development, orienting BIDV to become a carbon-
neutral/Net-zero bank in business operations according to domestic 
and international green/sustainability standards. In May 2024, with 
the support of Allotrope Partners, BIDV implemented a Greenhouse 
Gas Emissions Assessment Project and set targets according to 
international standards to assess and improve capacity in measuring 
and estimating greenhouse gas emissions (in all 3 scopes 1, 2, 3) as 
a basis for establishing a roadmap to transform into a Net-Zero Bank.
Pioneering bank in issuing Sustainability Report 
according to Global Reporting Initiative (GRI). BID 
stock has been selected by HOSE in the list of 20 most 
sustainable stocks in the Vietnamese Stock Market
BIDV is the pioneer bank in issuing an independent Sustainability 
Report according to international standards GRI and referring to the 
United Nations' sustainable development goals, providing transparent 
information for international organizations to evaluate the effectiveness 
and status of ESG implementation at BIDV. In July 2024, BID stock 
was selected by the Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange (HOSE) in the 
list of Vietnam Sustainable Development Index (VNSI), in the TOP 
20 enterprises with the highest sustainability score in the market. 
According to the announcement in November 2024 by the Sustainable 
Development Report Selection Council of the Ho Chi Minh City Stock 
Exchange. Ho Chi Minh Stock Exchange with technical support from 
professional partner, the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants 
(ACCA), BIDV's Sustainability Report was honored in the TOP 10 Best 
Sustainability Reports in the Vietnam Stock Market in 2024.
Pioneer in implementing social responsibility for the 
community, ensuring the rights of shareholders and 
employees
In addition to business activities, BIDV also affirms its pioneering 
role in fulfilling social responsibilities for the community, effectively 
implementing social security work, focusing on key areas in line with 
the Government's sustainable development orientation. BIDV is the 
pioneer bank in implementing the Program to reduce lending interest 
rates to support individuals and businesses affected by Typhoon Yagi. 
In 2024, BIDV has implemented nearly 200 social security sponsorship 
programs with a total amount of VND450 billion. Prioritizing funding 
for the fields of education, health, housing for the poor, overcoming the 
consequences of natural disasters, Tet gifts for the poor, etc. In 2024, 
BIDV continued to implement key social security programs for Green 
Life towards sustainable development. BIDV continued to implement 
the BIDV Run - For Green Life, BIDV Run - Warm Tet for The Poor, 
planting 1 million trees, building community houses to avoid floods, 
the "Fresh Water for Green Life" program donates 1,221 water tanks 
to support people to overcome drought and salinity disasters in the 
provinces of Bac Lieu, Ca Mau, Kien Giang, Tra Vinh, etc. 
BIDV always cares about creating a professional working environment, 
with promotion opportunities and attractive income for all employees, 
becoming a bank where all the best people want to work and contribute. 
In 2024, the average salary of employees increased by 7.4% compared 
to 2023, maintaining the growth momentum for five consecutive years. 
BIDV was honored with the award "Best Workplace in Asia 2024" and 
"The Best Employee Care Company 2024". The awards were presented 
by HR Asia Magazine, a prestigious magazine on human resources in 
Asia, based on the survey results of 704 Asian enterprises.
In 2024, BIDV completed paying stock dividends to all existing 
shareholders at a payout ratio of 21%. BIDV is committed to bringing 
sustainable, long-term benefits and values  to shareholders with 
stable dividends and increased stock value, creating a long-term bond 
between investors and the Bank, which is a stock that every investor 
wants to hold.
Once again, on behalf of BIDV's Board of Directors, I would like to 
express my sincere gratitude to all Customers, Shareholders, Investors, 
Partners and stakeholders who have trusted and supported BIDV over 
the past time.
CHAIRMAN OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS
Phan Duc Tu
